moments.text: Infrared view of plain grey sky, darker above, crosshair at centre. Up to three small bright dots drift slowly around crosshair level; their spacing keeps changing.
The image turns grainier and the three dots show as short slanted white streaks in a row across the middle, drifting left.
The picture darkens: crosshair over black sky just above bright cloud tops, with a thin streak of cloud stretched across.
The view zooms in: one small bright dot sits just below and left of the crosshair, cloud tops along the bottom edge.
Closer zoom, larger crosshair: the bright dot hangs just below the crosshair, a second dot upper right; a small dark ring lower left stays fixed.
The view widens again and the sensor pans slowly across bright clouds against dark sky, with a brief white flash at 2:42.
White and black flashes, then for about 1.4 s a much wider view of a long cloud bank, before it returns to the close-up.
Flashes again and another brief wide view of the cloud bank, then back to the close-up of clouds.
A third round of flashes and a short wide view of the cloud line; the close-up of clouds resumes until the clip ends.
